arxiv-2203-03510.title: Magnetic response of nematic superconductors: skyrmion stripes and their signatures in muon spin relaxation experiments
arxiv-2203-03510.creator: Martin Speight, Thomas Winyard, Egor Babaev
arxiv-2203-03510.description: Abstract We investigate the magnetic response of nematic superconductors, presenting a new approach to find vortex and skyrmion structures beyond symmetry-constraining ansätze. Using this approach we show that nematic superconductors form distinctive skyrmion stripes. Our approach lends itself to accurate determination of the field distribution for muon spin rotation probes.

arxiv-2406-03261.title: Setups for QCD-chemical potential baryogenesis with a dark sector
arxiv-2406-03261.creator: Shinya Matsuzaki
arxiv-2406-03261.description: Abstract I Preliminary model description We employ a chiral effective theory called the linear sigma model (LSM), in which color-singlet composite operators \bar{q}q and qqq are monitored by hadronic-interpolating fields. The LSM is built based on the chiral SU(2)_{L}\times SU(2)_{R} symmetry and its breaking structure.

arxiv-2412-13689.title: A bibliometric analysis and scoping study to identify English-language perspectives on slums
arxiv-2412-13689.creator: Katharina Henn, Michaela Leštáková, Kevin Logan, Jakob Hartig, Stefanos Georganos, John Friesen
arxiv-2412-13689.description: Abstract Slums, informal settlements, and deprived areas are urban regions characterized by poverty. According to the United Nations, over one billion people reside in these areas, and this number is projected to increase. Additionally, these settlements are integral components of urban systems.

arxiv-2502-01877.title: Precision measurement of the last bound states in H 2 and determination of the H + H scattering length
arxiv-2502-01877.creator: K.-F. Lai, W. Ubachs, M. Beyer
arxiv-2502-01877.description: Abstract The binding energies of the five bound rotational levels J = 0 − 4 J=0-4 in the highest vibrational level v = 14 v=14 in the X Σ + g 1 {}^{1}\Sigma_{g}^{+} ground electronic state of H 2 were measured in a three-step ultraviolet-laser experiment.

arxiv-2507-11280.title: A new framework of multidimensional pulsating stellar envelopes I.
arxiv-2507-11280.creator: Gábor B. Kovács, R. Szabó, J. Nuspl
arxiv-2507-11280.description: Abstract Context. The one-dimensional treatment of turbulent convection had large successes until the early 2000s. However, the recent abundance and precision of observational data shows that this problem is far from solved. Even so, ongoing theoretical debates about proper one-equation-based treatment of convection and new results show that it has various other theoretical difficulties as well.

pmc-10706364.title: Glycation Interferes with the Expression of Sialyltransferases and Leads to Increased Polysialylation in Glioblastoma Cells
pmc-10706364.creator: Paola Schildhauer, Philipp Selke, Martin S. Staege, Anja Harder, Christian Scheller, Christian Strauss, Rüdiger Horstkorte, Maximilian Scheer, Sandra Leisz
pmc-10706364.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive brain tumor that often utilizes aerobic glycolysis for energy production (Warburg effect), resulting in increased methylglyoxal (MGO) production. MGO, a reactive dicarbonyl compound, causes protein alterations and cellular dysfunction via glycation. In this study, we investigated the effect of glycation on sialylation, a common post-translational modification implicated in cancer.

pmc-11350227.title: Analysis of Intelligent Equipment Usage for Work-Related Musculoskeletal Disorders Prevention in Miners — Shanxi Province, China, 2023
pmc-11350227.creator: Haimiao Yu, Zepeng Xu, Ying Xia, Shuo Zhang, Xiaoting Jia
pmc-11350227.description: What is already known about this topic?Work-related musculoskeletal disorders (WMSDs) are prevalent in the workforce and occur across various industries. Surveys show that the prevalence of WMSDs among miners is generally over 50%.What is added by this report?High levels of intelligent equipment usage (IEU) can decrease the prevalence of WMSDs among miners by 7.49% and reduce pain by 13.

pmc-11522736.title: Recurrent Annular Thrombosis and Embolism Following Mitral Valve Repair
pmc-11522736.creator: Saloni Agrawal, David H Adams, Martin E Goldman, Caroline I Cromwell, Dimosthenis Pandis, Jonathan L Halperin
pmc-11522736.description: A patient without evident systemic thrombophilia developed recurrent ischemic stroke following surgical mitral valve repair. Thromboembolism proved resistant to anticoagulation; however, following explantation of the prosthesis, she became asymptomatic with normal valve function. We postulate that an unusual reaction to prosthetic material was the source of thromboembolism.

pmc-11585955.title: Ethnic foods of Northeast India: insight into the light of food safety
pmc-11585955.creator: Madhuchhanda Das, Anup Kumar Ojha, Pallab Sarmah, Dimpu Gogoi, Karma G Dolma, Tapan Majumdar, Suranjana Chaliha Hazarika, Dilem Modi, Goutam Chowdhury, Chaitali Konwar, Reema Nath, Samaresh Das, Thandavarayan Ramamurthy
pmc-11585955.description: BackgroundTraditional and fermented foods are widely consumed by the ethnic population of Northeast India. These foods are not only very nutritious, easily available, and reasonably priced, but also boost immunity and protect from various seasonal infections and have been reported through several investigations. However, pathogens transmitted by these foods have never been reported.

pmc-12365202.title: Mesaconic acid as a key metabolite with anti-inflammatory and anti-aging properties produced by Lactobacillus plantarum 124 from centenarian gut microbiota
pmc-12365202.creator: Lei Wu, Hongxin He, Tingting Liang, Guowei Du, Longyan Li, Haojie Zhong, Ying Li, Jinke Zhang, Ning Chen, Tong Jiang, Juan Yang, Jiangyan Wang, Shuo Feng, Shenghua Lu, Hui Zhao, Qihui Gu, He Gao, Guanghui Li, Wenrui Xie, Lihao Wu, Qingping Wu, Xinqiang Xie, Xingxiang He
pmc-12365202.description: The gut microbiota of centenarians plays a vital role in promoting healthy longevity. We performed a cross-sectional study of 224 people from Jiaoling, China, which is globally recognised for the longevity of its residents. Compared with younger people, centenarians showed significantly increased alpha-diversity, enrichment of the beneficial bacteria Lactobacillus, Akkermansia, and Christensenella, and increased redox capacity in the gut microbiota.

pmc-12696016.title: Protection of metal interfaces against hydrogen-assisted cracking
pmc-12696016.creator: Guillaume Hachet, Shaolou Wei, Ali Tehranchi, Xizhen Dong, Jérémy Lestang, Aochen Zhang, Binhan Sun, Stefan Zaefferer, Baptiste Gault, Dirk Ponge, Dierk Raabe
pmc-12696016.description: Enabling a hydrogen economy requires the development of materials resistant to hydrogen embrittlement (HE). More than 100 years of research have led to several mechanisms and models describing how hydrogen interacts with lattice defects and leads to mechanical property degradation. However, solutions to protect materials from hydrogen are still scarce.

pmc-12706937.title: The relationship between transition shock and person-organization fit among newly graduated registered nurses in China: the mediating role of resilience
pmc-12706937.creator: Liu Feng, Yutao Zeng, Xiaorong Chen, Yan Zhang, Juan Zhang
pmc-12706937.description: BackgroundA substantial body of research has been accumulated regarding the transition shock of newly graduated registered nurses (NGRNs). However, studies on person-organization fit remain insufficient. Improving person-organization fit among NGRNs can positively enhance job satisfaction, reduce turnover rates, and improve the quality of care.

pmc-13083794.title: New legal category of ‘advanced regenerative medicine treatment’ in Korea’s amended regenerative medicine law: comparative lessons from Japan
pmc-13083794.creator: Jinah Yoon, Sukhyang Lee, Jung-Hyun Kim
pmc-13083794.description: South Korea’s Act on the Safety of and Support for Advanced Regenerative Medicine and Advanced Biological Products, enacted in 2019, was recently amended. This article examines the new advanced regenerative medicine treatment (ARMT) category, focusing on patient access, review processes, safety monitoring, ethical safeguards, and lessons from Japan’s comparable framework.

pmc-13483422.title: Relating aqueous to vitreous humor proteomics for identification of reliable biomarkers in proliferative diabetic retinopathy
pmc-13483422.creator: Ingeborg Klaassen, Michael WT Tanck, Holly J Duncan, Elif Yildiz, Reinier O Schlingemann, David HW Steel
pmc-13483422.description: This study aimed to identify aqueous humor (AQ) proteins that correlate with vitreous humor (VH) levels in proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR). Using paired VH and AQ samples from 41 patients undergoing vitrectomy for PDR, we measured 92 protein biomarkers via a high-throughput immunoassay.

pmc-13552184.creator: Hamza Janjua, Monica Wilbekin, Hira Janjua, Kushal Das, Zulfiqar Qutrio Baloch, Rehan Ishaque
